- [ASSISTANT_SAID] FIFA has introduced new rules for the 2022 World Cup, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Five substitutions: each team can make up to five substitutions in three separate time periods.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yellow card suspension: a yellow card suspension applies only for the match in which it was received; players receiving two yellow cards in separate matches will not be suspended for the following match.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Penalty kicks: a goalkeeper must have at least one foot on the goal line when a penalty kick is taken.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Video Assistant Referee (VAR): VAR technology will continue to assist referees in decision-making.
